tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: The kinds of business Vaeo makes reports for. A business of another kind cannot be ordered yet.

tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Search Google Maps for an Australian business by name and suburb, for example "Corner Dental Newtown". Gives each match's place_id for get_questions and order_report.

tools.name: get_questions
tools.description: For one business: its details, our trade for it, the questions a report asks the AIs, and the price in A$.

tools.name: order_report
tools.description: Start an order and get a Stripe payment link. Nothing is charged here: the person opens the link and pays on Stripe's page, and gets the report by email. Give the person the link and the price. Keep the order_key to follow the order. With compare_with_place_id (a business of the same trade in the sa

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: Where an order is: not paid yet, being made, waiting, in its final check, done, or failed.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The finished report as data: how often the AIs named the business, its place among the businesses they named, each AI, each question, the sites the AIs cited, its website check, and "Start here" (at most 3 things to do first, each with the fact and count behind it).

tools.name: ask_about_report
tools.description: One part of a finished report, from the saved results (no new AI questions, no cost). Topics: short_answer, who_the_ais_named (who is named more), each_ai, each_question, pages_the_ais_read (which sites to get on), website, start_here (what to do first).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order_report · Public sink: order_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order_report · Public sink: order_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
